support.faqQuestion1: Ta yaya zan haɗa sabon laptop ko allon gabatarwa?
support.faqAnswer1: Shigar da MakeChurchEazy desktop app, shiga, sannan buɗe Devices a dashboard don haɗa kwamfutar. Idan ba ka amfani da OBS, kwafi presentation link daga presentation mode ka buɗe shi a allon da kake son nunawa.
support.faqQuestion2: Ta yaya ake lissafin credits na AI?
support.faqAnswer2: Ana amfani da credits na AI don fasali kamar Speech to Scripture da fassara. Amfani ya dogara da fasalin da adadin rubutu ko sauti da aka sarrafa. Za ka iya duba ma’auninka a shafin Credits.
support.faqQuestion3: Zan iya amfani da app ba tare da intanet ba?
support.faqAnswer3: Yawancin aikin gabatarwa na iya ci gaba a gida bayan songs, Bible versions, media, da themes sun shirya. Ana bukatar intanet don shiga, sync, downloads, updates, AI tools, da billing.
support.faqQuestion4: Ta yaya zan canza plan dina?
support.faqAnswer4: Je zuwa Subscription > Plans don kwatanta Free, Basic, da Growth. Upgrade zai buɗe limits da credits na plan ɗin bayan an tabbatar da payment.

support.stillNeedHelpDesc: Tawagarmu tana nan don taimaka maka da kowace matsala.
support.faqQ1: Ta yaya zan haɗa sabon laptop ko allon gabatarwa?
support.faqA1: Shigar da MakeChurchEazy desktop app, shiga, sannan buɗe Devices a dashboard don haɗa kwamfutar. Don nunawa ba tare da OBS ba, kwafi presentation link daga presentation mode ka buɗe shi a allon da kake son nunawa.
support.faqQ2: Ta yaya credits na AI ke aiki?
support.faqA2: Credits na AI suna ba da ƙarfi ga Speech to Scripture, translations, da wasu AI tools. Kowane fasali yana cin credits gwargwadon aikin da aka yi. Duba balance da history a shafin Credits.
support.faqQ3: Ta yaya zan haɗa MakeChurchEazy da OBS?
support.faqA3: Buɗe settings na desktop app, saka OBS WebSocket host, port, da password, sannan connect. Za ka iya amfani da presentation browser link idan kana son nunawa ba tare da sarrafa OBS ba.
support.faqQ4: Ta yaya zan canza plan ko billing?
support.faqA4: Buɗe Subscription > Plans don ganin Free, Basic, da Growth. Idan upgrade ya tabbata, limits da credits na plan ɗin za su fara aiki a account.
support.faqA5: Account ɗinka yana amfani da secure authentication da encrypted network connections. Za ka iya duba active sessions, passwords, da connected devices daga Security da Devices pages.
support.faqQ6: Zan iya amfani da MakeChurchEazy a alluna da yawa?
support.faqA6: Eh. Za ka iya amfani da OBS browser sources, presentation browser link, ko extended display gwargwadon kwamfutar hidima da projector.
support.faqA7: Local presentation actions ya kamata su kasance masu sauri a machine ɗaya ko local network ɗaya. Ana amfani da intanet musamman don sign-in, sync, downloads, updates, AI features, da billing.
support.faqQ8: Ta yaya zan sake saita password dina?
support.faqA8: Je zuwa login page, zaɓi Forgot Password, kuma saka email ɗinka. Idan ka yi rajista da Google, yi amfani da Sign in with Google.

support.guideSongsStepFour: Yayin hidima, buɗe Worship tab a dock ka danna section da kake son nunawa.
support.guideMediaIntro: Yi amfani da wannan don hotuna, bidiyo, countdown screens, da background changes a presentation output.

support.guideMediaStepTwo: Zaɓi media item a dock idan kana son ya bayyana a screen.
support.guideMediaStepThree: Yi amfani da backgrounds ga Bible da Worship slides idan kana son text a kan image, color, ko video.
support.guideMediaStepFour: Yi amfani da countdowns kafin hidima ko lokacin transitions, sannan stop ko replace su idan ka shirya.
